context.body: Selected for the reader trail because “They look, mourn, and remain named by households” preserves a distinct antecedent source unit within anticipation.

observations.body: The passage describes looking on the pierced one and a great mourning distributed among named families and their wives.
observations.label: They look, mourn, and remain named by households: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps looking, piercing, mourning visible within its Crucifixion evidence.

payload.posture: Read Zechariah 12:10–14 as its own anticipation and stated approach crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The passage materially bears on the Crucifixion while leaving part of its motive, mechanism, or later significance unstated.
payload.title: They look, mourn, and remain named by households
